items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Stanley Cowell, the piano player who did a couple of things with you

ctx.x: Strata-East. Stanley Cowell, the piano player who did a couple of things with you, and Charles Tolliver. They were the co-owners of the label at the time. So that was probably right around 1970 when it came out. It was apparently one of the early things.
